title: ## SURVEY OF CRIME ## I.P.C. Crimes 9,55,422 Cognizable Crimes under the Indian Penal Code were reported in India during 1970 showing an increase of 13.0% over 1969. This figure includes crimes committed by Juveniles. The trend of crime during the sixties shows a rise till the year 1967, except for marginal decreases in 1963 and 1965. There was a decrease from 1967 to 1969 and during 1970 there has been a very sharp increase.
